summary: Employers Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 results, declaring a regular quarterly dividend of $0.34 per share payable May 27, 2026 to holders of record May 13, 2026, and authorizing a new $125 million share repurchase program (2026 Program) effective May 4, 2026 through December 31, 2027, replacing a fully utilized prior program. Repurchases may occur in open market or private transactions under Rules 10b5-1 and 10b-18. The dividend increase and buyback authorization signal a capital return to shareholders. Watch execution pace and any future program extensions.
